source.content: public class LocalCallable implements System.Callable { public Object call(String action, Map<String,Object> args) { if (action == 'echo') { return args.get('value'); } return action; } }

@isTest private class CoreRuntimeCallableInterfaceDispatchTest { @isTest static void callableDispatchesUserImplementation() { System.Callable callable = new LocalCallable(); Map<String,Object> args = new Map<String,Object>{ 'value' => 'local' }; System.assertEquals('local', (String)callable.call('echo', args)); } }

notes: A user implementation is invoked through the System.Callable interface.
